  • Method Details

    • settle

      public PaymentExecutionStatusChanged settle(SettleInternalPaymentCommand command)
      Settles the reserved sender debit and recipient credit, records SETTLED, settles fees, and creates statement/notification effects for each participating account. All writes must share the submit transaction.
      Parameters:
      command - identifies the authorized internal payment
      Returns:
      confirmed LOCKED-to-SETTLED lifecycle event
